title: How is Hitler connected to Elmo?
description: Four real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Elmo from Sesame Street, through Franco, the King of Spain and a first lady.

links.line: In 1940, Hitler met Spain's dictator, Francisco Franco, at the French border.

image.file: File:In Madrid is herdacht dat Franco 30 jaar geleden de burgeroorlog ( 1936 1939 ) w, Bestanddeelnr 922-4913 (cropped).jpg

links.line: In 1969, Franco named young Prince Juan Carlos as his successor.

image.file: File:Sofia, Laura Bush, George W. Bush and Juan Carlos.jpg

links.line: In 2001, King Juan Carlos welcomed Laura Bush to Madrid.

image.file: File:Mrs. Laura Bush and daughters pose for a photo with Sesame Street character Elmo.jpg

links.line: And in 2007, at a Sesame Street dinner, Laura Bush posed with Elmo.
